limits: No real serialized receiver fixture or platform collection evidence yet; source evidence is not runtime verification.
Internal delivery independence from integration gather errors still requires real receiver evidence.
Windows native CPU, available RAM, eligible disk pair, net and uptime require platform validation; win_perf_counters is available but no counter metric is claimed verified.
Five service names and numeric fields are source-derived; actual availability depends on server versions, privileges and connectivity.

transport.metricNameRule: measurement + '_' + field; sanitized; no implicit _total or unit suffix
transport.metadata: Remote Write v1 samples do not carry Telegraf gauge/counter/untyped distinctions; semantic types below must be retained by consumers.
transport.notes: Serializer owns compression. HTTP headers above must be rendered explicitly; do not enable additional HTTP snappy compression. Authorization Bearer AGT must be bound from the local credential through config.Secret in memory; this descriptor contains no credential or identity values.

identity.serviceInstanceRule: Renderer supplies stable DB integration-instance identifier through input tags for every service block; upstream plugins do not generate it. Preserve across edits, reject missing IDs, never derive from endpoint or password.
identity.tagPolicy: Retain only per-family allowlists plus authenticated gateway labels; omit endpoint/credential-bearing and high-churn tags. Descriptor policies require later renderer implementation.

cpu.semantics: Host used CPU percent = 100 - aggregate idle percent; first gather has no usage sample; skip zero delta. Do not sum per-core percentages.

memory.semantics: Available RAM, not merely free RAM; used fraction = 1 - available / total, only when total > 0.

disk.semantics: Available-space utilization = 100 * (1 - free / total), matched on identical eligible volume labels with total > 0; select worst eligible volume, never aggregate free/total across volumes. On Unix, free uses Bavail while used uses Blocks-Bfree: used/total understates reserved/unavailable space and cannot replace this pair. Upstream used_percent (used/(used+free)) is also not this formula. Later platform profile must exclude pseudo/temporary/duplicate mounts; Windows available-space behavior remains runtime-unverified.

network.semantics: Rate separately by interface, accounting for reset; exclude loopback/duplicate virtual paths in later platform profile.

uptime.semantics: Host uptime from host.Uptime(), never agent process age. Explicit include=[uptime] uses AddFields/untyped, unlike legacy mode's AddCounter. No load averages required or fabricated on Windows.

load.semantics: Linux system profile combines load1 and host uptime in one native input; this OS-specific config supersedes the uptime-only config on Linux. Windows retains include=[uptime] and never fabricates load. Load is a dimensionless gauge, never a rate.

delivery.semantics: Numeric internal family with gather-time sample timestamp from selfstat.Metrics(), which calls time.Now() internally; freshness follows delivery even if counter value does not change. Independent input registration exists in source; gather-error receiver proof remains unverified. Not a replacement for authenticated heartbeat or host uptime.

numbackends.name: postgresql_numbackends
numbackends.fieldType: SQL integer normalized to int64; server column dependent

postgresql.semantics: One row per pg_stat_database; numbackends is server-provided column. Database label must remain to avoid colliding series; sanitized server address is dropped.

mysql.semantics: Metric version 2 lowercases SHOW GLOBAL STATUS names, unlike legacy prefix mappings; numeric conversion follows server value.

docker.semantics: Engine-info numeric metric only; exclude container IDs, images, labels and names from this core allowlist.

deferred: Linux and Windows runtime platform evidence
